regions.full_page: God Bless you and yours. Many thanks for favor of the 19th just noted. Am enrolling you and family and the holy suf- fering Souls for your guidance. Glad of your interesting meet. on the first. Mrs O'Malley sent me word about it yesterday. Now I must tell you something that, in a way, I do not like to do. Its this. The arch enemy of our Blessed Mother and of im- mortal souls, at all times on the alert, must have received an ex- tra length of rope these days. I have been reported as having been phoning you longdistance and the "Agradan . Society"! ! ! Whatever the source, it seems to have given important offense, if not scandal . . Therefore, I wish that for the present and until you be better known and your efforts recognized, you leave me out of the picture. Afterall if Venerable Mary of Agrata is a saint, about which I find it personally unreasonable to doubt, then., in my way of thinking, its high time she get active in working a miracle of some kind, in clearing away the prejudice or jealousy or at least misunderstanding that has hampered her work --- which is not hers but God's work --- and hes pressed on your sholders for three years and on mine for at least seven.
